title: skills: seeds.md and objectstack-platform SKILL.md still teach seed mode insert / replace, which #34613 retires
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPJxG4vBVaLCBWLcWJ

Filing gate ①: the `Skills-docs: follow-up` card of PR #34791 (card #34613), passed on by area `o2-A` on the seat's word. Not a skills-lane change in that PR.

Suggested-grade: p2 · documentation · `skills/**`

Blocked-by: #34613

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34613(PR #34791)按维护者裁定 B 退役 seed 的 `insert` 和 `replace` 模式；但 `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` 与 `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 仍在教这两种模式。
- 为什么要修：照技能写种子的 AI 会写出 #34791 合入后被加载器拒收的数据集。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

After PR #34791 merges, rewrite the two passages: an unkeyed dataset uses the default mode with a composite `externalId` (or `id`); `insert` / `replace` are refused and name that conversion. Take the wording from #34791's refusal message and migration entry. Add or adjust a skills eval if one covers seed modes.

## Done when

`git grep -nE "mode: '(insert|replace)'" skills/` shows no line teaching either mode as usable.
